description: Bounded list bookkeeping atoms with bounds-checked push/pop/peek/len, modelled as a direct extension of the safe_queue.mm pattern. Proves the len <= capacity invariant for push/pop using Z3 integer theory — no array theory required. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/container/safe_list — verified bounded list'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/container/safe_queue.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm and std/container/safe_queue.mm already use (checked_add, checked_sub, conditional expressions). The `arr` parameter is an opaque i64 handle to the underlying buffer; bookkeeping is performed on `len` and `capacity` only.

atoms.name: safe_push
atoms.description: Bounded push with overflow check. Mirrors enqueue from safe_queue.mm but exposes the underlying buffer handle and pushed value as parameters so the caller can prove element-level invariants (val >= 0).

atoms.name: safe_pop
atoms.description: Safe pop with underflow check. Mirrors dequeue from safe_queue.mm.

atoms.name: safe_peek
atoms.description: Bounds-checked element access. Returns a non-negative element value; the caller is responsible for ensuring elements were inserted with safe_push (val >= 0).

atoms.name: safe_len
atoms.description: Identity length accessor. Exposes the bookkeeping length so external code can reason about list size without touching the buffer handle.
